meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

That's a machine's guess, and the people who sell it say in their own guide it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure says the same. Was Owen heard before you entered it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

Owen doesn't lie, Hale, and you've just called him a cheater with nothing but a percentage. Fourteen of these tools were tested in 2023 and found neither accurate nor reliable. I'll be in the principal's office when we're finished here.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

So his record depends on whether his mother complains. I'm writing that down, and I want it from you in writing tonight. Put anything on his file and it goes to the principal and then the board under section 42.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your statement about his record in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing ever placed on his record, which is not the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her anything dated from Owen's own work that she could check.
What cost ground: Threatening to put it on his permanent record if she kept fighting, because that hit her one non-negotiable and made his record look like leverage against her complaint.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed only the checker score, so nothing you said came near that night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: At your very first turn, instead of leading with the checker score, admit in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show her one specific, dated piece of Owen's own work that she can check herself.
